integrity_statement: The formulas are justified by an explicit log-odds conjugacy and classical rotation results; finite verification does not replace the infinite proof. All comparisons identify the relevant assumptions and their limits.
scientific_limitations: Only the uncoupled deterministic two-constant-likelihood anti-confirmation update is classified; conclusions use each agent local update clock.
No claim about in-group coupling, stochastic empirical realism, wall-clock frequencies with unequal agent schedules, or coupled network chaotic dynamics.
The zero branchwise Lyapunov exponent excludes initial conditions with an orbit that hits the discontinuity; all orbit and frequency conclusions include such points.
Originality is assessed against inspected primary literature and searches; globally exhaustive prior-art exclusion is not possible.
title: Irrational rotation and exact switching balance in anti-confirmation Bayesian beliefs
